text: All tests pass. The fix was minimal: in `grid/spiral.py`, the bottom-row pass now only runs when `top != bottom`, and the left-column pass only runs when `left != right`. Previously, for a single-row matrix the bottom row was the same as the top row (so it got re-appended in reverse), and for a single column the left column was the same as the right column (re-appended in reverse) — that's why `spiral([[1, 2, 3]])` produced `[1, 2, 3, 2, 1]` and the 3×4 matrix produced more than 12 values.
